title: Provision local builder workspace: project-LICHEN/zephyr is a broken symlink (v3.7.0 tree absent on this box)
description: Found while attempting local native_sim build for 5fva.1. ~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN has a full local Zephyr env (SDK 0.16.8 at ~/Developer/zephyr-sdk, lichen-venv with west, env script ~/Developer/lichen-env.sh) BUT project-LICHEN/zephyr -> ../zephyr is a broken symlink (same defect as the Mac checkout, bead project-LICHEN-worker6-xplt) - the v3.7.0 zephyr clone is absent, so west build fails with 'workspace does not define extension command build' and ZEPHYR_BASE dangles. Fix: run west update in that workspace (manifest path lichen, west.yml pins v3.7.0) to clone zephyr + modules, or copy a known-good v3.7.0 tree in. After provisioning, native_sim builds can run locally without heft. Note: workspace checkout is at sync commit 50480b97e5, only .beads noise dirty.
close_reason: Resolved on heft - the workspace was provisioned since this bead was filed. Verified this round: (1) ~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/zephyr -> ../zephyr resolves to a full Zephyr tree (git describe: v4.1.0) - NOT broken; (2) project-LICHEN has its own .west (standalone workspace, manifest lichen/west.yml pins v4.1.0 on heft, not v3.7.0); (3) west build works: multiple native_sim/native/64 builds ran this session (ping_l2 debug builds for 5fva.1, fresh-build probe for rpl_dodag). The v3.7.0-pin parity builds remain the AWS builder's role per AGENTS.md, and heft's local v4.1.0 env is the documented local path. One caveat for main-branch fresh builds until the worker7 merge lands: main's test_common.cmake uses unconditional -std=c23 which gcc-13 rejects (verified: fresh rpl_dodag configure+build fails on that flag); worker7 commit ea8c77bebf already carries the -std=c23 probe with -std=c2x fallback, so this resolves at merge (also tracked via mrp5 for the conversion warnings the fallback unmasks).
